pieces.name: Countdown card
pieces.explains: How long until a date: a big number, the date, where it's on, the same time in hours, then a follow card.
pieces.use_when: Launch countdowns, event countdowns, 'X days until'. Any brand: change accent and bgTop/bgBottom.
pieces.dont_use_when: The number isn't a time span (use a counter or comparison piece instead).
pieces.remix: om set days=7 hours=168 unit=DAYS pieces/M01-countdown-card && om render pieces/M01-countdown-card --workers 3

ideas.name: A-vs-B magnitude bars
ideas.line: There are more trees on Earth than stars in our galaxy.
ideas.why_new: Nothing in the library compares two huge numbers. Two bars grow to scale (3 trillion vs 100–400 billion, with the range shown as a faded band), and the winner label lands on the beat.
ideas.reuse: Any 'more X than Y' fact; GTA map sizes (Vice City vs Los Santos).

ideas.name: Ratio dots
ideas.line: So the animals make their own. About three in four of them can glow.
ideas.why_new: We say '3 in 4' but show nothing that counts. A 4-dot (or 100-dot) grid where the right share lights up one by one makes the ratio visible.
ideas.reuse: Any 'N in M' or percentage fact; poll results; 'only 1 in 10 players…'.

ideas.name: Fact-or-fake stamp
ideas.line: Follow for more facts that sound fake, but aren't.
ideas.why_new: Our sign-off line is spoken over nothing. A FAKE? stamp flips to a REAL stamp with the source name, which turns the brand promise into a picture and a repeatable end card.
ideas.reuse: Fact-reels end card; Wanted Level rumour checks (REAL / NOT CONFIRMED / FAKE) with 2–3 short caveats.

ideas.name: Face-off thermometer
ideas.line: Researchers in France measured about six thousand degrees … The Sun's surface is about five and a half thousand.
ideas.why_new: Two temperatures are said 4 seconds apart and the viewer has to hold the first in their head. One gauge with two needles (core 6,000 °C, Sun 5,500 °C) shows the gap at once.
ideas.reuse: Any two readings on one scale: speed, depth, price, time.

ideas.name: Light-delay timeline
ideas.line: Its light takes about eight minutes and twenty seconds to reach your eyes.
ideas.why_new: A delay is hard to feel from a number. A line from 'left the Sun' to 'reached you' with a clock running 8:20, then the same line zoomed out to 2.5 million years for Andromeda.
ideas.reuse: Travel times, delays, 'how long ago' facts; GTA in-game vs real time.

ideas.name: Three-part plan panel
ideas.source: GTA pilot (planned): 'Can you make money clipping GTA 6?'
ideas.line: Three chapters: the claim, how to do it, is it real.
ideas.why_new: Our chapter reels have a depth HUD but no on-screen chapter list. A panel with three tabs (the third locked until the end) and a progress bar keeps an open loop running for 60–90 s. Our own design in Wanted Level amber/navy.
ideas.reuse: Every Wanted Level explainer; fact-reel chapter episodes; '5 tips' posts as 5 tabs.

ideas.name: Early-or-late dial
ideas.line: Are you early, or already too late?
ideas.why_new: A verdict needs a picture. A half-dial needle swings from LATE to EARLY (or any two labels) and settles on the answer.
ideas.reuse: Worth it / not worth it, hype vs reality, beginner vs pro verdicts.

ideas.name: Race clock + step counter overlay
ideas.source: Instagram reel DfoSh7SM1N5 (GTA clipping tutorial, studied 2026-11-13)
ideas.line: Using GTA 6 to ... in under 40 seconds (Step 1 ... Step 8, with a running stopwatch)
ideas.why_new: M01 is a full-screen countdown card. Nothing in the library runs a live stopwatch over footage while numbered steps tick by; the clock is the proof device ('it really is this quick').
ideas.reuse: Any how-to or speed-run reel: setup walkthroughs, 'X in 60 seconds' facts, app demos (family-chores 'start a chore in 10 seconds').

ideas.name: Guide line + label on footage
ideas.source: IG saves review 2026-11-13: fitness saves (posture fix, 28M plays)
ideas.line: Fix your anterior pelvic tilt (dashed line from hip to knee, one label)
ideas.why_new: Nothing in the library annotates live footage; a dashed line draws on, a pill label pops at its end, then a second line shows the corrected angle.
ideas.reuse: Science facts on real footage, GTA map routes, app UI callouts.

ideas.name: Highlighted body part / object part
ideas.source: IG saves review 2026-11-13: fitness saves (muscle highlight on a 3D figure)
ideas.line: the muscle that does the work glows red on a grey figure
ideas.why_new: Our Blender pieces show whole objects; none highlights one part and labels it while the rest dims.
ideas.reuse: Anatomy facts, engine parts, planet layers (earth-core reel).

ideas.name: Stacked label ladder
ideas.source: IG saves review 2026-11-13: sports drill reel (SPEED / AGILITY / … rows)
ideas.line: eight stacked rows, each a word + a small looping demo
ideas.why_new: No list piece where each row is a live mini-scene; good for 'N things' countdowns.
ideas.reuse: Countdowns (top 10 skills), step lists, chapter menus.

ideas.name: Score badge + item cut-out (1–10 ranking)
ideas.source: IG save 2026-11-15: 'Expert ranks supplements for focus 1–10'
ideas.why_new: No piece ranks items with a big score badge over a cut-out of the thing being ranked; ascending order saves the best for last.
ideas.reuse: GTA 6 features ranked, body parts by renewal speed, family apps ranked.
